description: A crescent prism one high, its two top arcs filleted at 0.1 so that the stripes meet on their own section from the top's contact (-1.7, -0.8485, 1) down to the spine at (-2, 0, 0.9) (the mutual trim, ADR-0084), the cusp vertex gone. Split by the vertical plane y = -0.3, which crosses both stripes and the section edge; the side away from the cusp (y < -0.3) is the result. Held to the mutual trim of Open CASCADE's two single-edge fillets, combined by common and then given the same later steps (tools/oracle/cusp_corner_closure.py): a construction by the same law from an independent kernel's exact single-edge stripes, which agrees with the second oracle's runs of the crescent to 1.3e-9 of the body (ADR-0084, ADR-0073); Open CASCADE's own result of the recipe has its corner patch and is the record in expected.json. Volume and inertia are held at 5e-9, not 1e-9: the section's fit budget, 2.5e-8 (ADR-0042, ADR-0062), no longer cancels where the cut puts a vertex on it (the same cuts of the chamfered crescent, whose exact volumes a 20-digit quadrature gives, are Arris-off by 1 to 5e-9), and the reference itself agrees with the second oracle's runs only to 1.3e-9 of the body at this size.

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE keeps its corner patch as an extra face (V / E / F 13 / 20 / 9); the stripes need none, and run on they meet on their own section, which is what Open CASCADE's common of its two single-edge fillets and Arris build (ADR-0084)
analytic.measure_differs: Open CASCADE's corner patch is an approximation that misses its neighbours by up to 6.1e-3 and does not close (the crescent fixture's measure_differs); the record is the exact mutual trim from its single-edge fillets, whose agreement with the second oracle is in regression/cusp-corner-crescent-fillet/second.json (ADR-0073, ADR-0084)

occt_step_refused.why: Open CASCADE's corner patch misses its neighbours by up to its tolerance there, 6.1e-3 (6 % of r): its own STEP writes the patch's boundary with a gap of 5.6e-3, past the reader's cap of 2.3e-3 for a part this size, and closing it would move geometry. Arris's own STEP is still read back by Open CASCADE and compared
